final_message:
The fix has been applied successfully. The issue was that the condition `if len(cur) + extra > width - 1:` was incorrectly checking against `width - 1` instead of `width`. This caused words to be split prematurely because the calculation was double-counting aspects of the string length.

The corrected code now properly checks `if len(cur) + extra > width:`, which ensures words stay together as long as they fit within the specified width. The test for `wrap('aaa bbb ccc', 7)` now correctly returns `['aaa bbb', 'ccc']`.
